task_name: Dummy-mode parity for detail and PDF

strengths: Config-driven branching via config/app.dummy_mode with DummyModeService.enabled() used in InvoiceController@show and pdf()
DummySeeder seeds deterministic INV-DUMMY-0001 with two product_name_snapshot line items and three payments covering failed/pending/completed ordered newest first
Static PDF blob pre-generated once in DummySeeder via PdfGeneratorService.generate() and cached under DummyModeService::PDF_CACHE_KEY, reused verbatim in pdfResponse without Dompdf invocation
Canonical filename extracted to PdfGeneratorService.filename() shared by real stream() and dummy pdfResponse() preventing header drift (INV-YYYYMMDD-{id}.pdf)
Zero-network guarantee verified: InvoiceController pdf() early-returns dummy blob before getDetail/template/Pdf load; show() returns cached detail
